meta.source: RBI — ATM, Acceptance Infrastructure and Card Statistics (monthly)

festive.note: Diwali fell on 20 October 2025 but 8 November 2026, moving the pre-festive sales peak from September to October. September 2025 was therefore a festive-inflated base and September 2026 was not, so same-month value comparisons across that pair understate growth. Transaction volume, which is far less sensitive to the shift, is the more reliable year-on-year read.

notes: All figures are as reported by banks to the RBI and are provisional.

flags.note: Axis Bank's reported UPI QR codes jumped from 13.1 crore in Aug-26 to 19.4 crore in Sep-26 and 30.9 crore in Oct-26, having added roughly 0.1 crore a month before that. No other sponsor bank's count fell to match, so this reads as a reporting or portfolio-sponsorship change rather than 17.8 crore QR codes being deployed in two months. It is what takes the national total past 100 crore.

ICICI Bank's reported PoS terminals dropped from 21.5 lakh to 1.6 lakh and its Bharat QR count to zero in Jun-26, while its ATM, card and spending figures stayed normal. Treated as a reporting reclassification, not a real change in the network.
